scoring_justification: T1 feasible: the checker recomputes the minimum transmittance from the agent's raw CSV and compares to the paper's 90% threshold; also performs a structural comparison of frustum vs pyramid.

outputs.description: Power transmittance curves. The checker will verify that the minimum transmittance_frustum over 0.5–5 THz meets the efficiency threshold (threshold_or_better) and that transmittance_frustum > transmittance_pyramid at all sampled frequencies (structural).

output_contract.notes: The RCWA simulation uses constant GaP refractive index n=3.34. The scored check combines a threshold (min transmittance >= 0.9) and a structural comparison (frustum outperforms pyramid).

steps.description: Minimum transmittance_frustum over 0.5-5 THz must be >= 0.9
transmittance_frustum > transmittance_pyramid at all sampled frequencies in 0.5-5 THz
